draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 6.00, the 138th-best grade among 259 2023 draftees and 17th of 32 at WR. He went 55th overall, well ahead of where his grade ranked (138th): teams liked him more than the published grade. Testing standouts: 10-yard split (88th percentile), vertical jump (94th percentile). College production: his final season (2022) ranked 3rd in receiving yards among the 32 WRs in his class with stats.

current.summary: Year 4 pro, currently with the Kansas City Chiefs. 28 career games and 20 starts over 3 completed seasons, plus 4 so far in 2026. Producing near his peak: 6 AV in 2025 against a career-best 8 in 2023. Strengths in 2025: yards after catch per reception 7.8 (96th percentile), catch rate 68.0% (77th percentile), receiving td 5 (76th percentile). Weak spots: drop rate 6.4% (24th percentile). Played 8 of 17 games in 2025. Versus the typical Year-3 wide receiver who played: 571 receiving yards against a median of 346, above the norm.
